why: SDD v0101 L4:引擎參數從參數冊讀、不寫死。系統庫 syscat 的掃描範圍、輸出位置、卡片大小與預設查詢都在這裡;改這本冊(出新版號)就改行為,不必改程式。
data_boundary: 只收程式結構、冊的中繼資料與號;不收 VIA_Reports、資料湖、研報、.parquet / .duckdb / .csv / .pdf(CLAUDE.md 資料邊界)

fam.sql: SELECT family, system, folder, versions, first_version, tail_version, tail_code, tail_doc FROM families WHERE lower(family) LIKE lower(?) ORDER BY family, folder
fam.what: 家族:版數 · 首尾版 · 尾版號 · 首行說明

code.sql: SELECT book, code, name, system FROM numbers WHERE code = ? OR lower(name) LIKE lower(?) ORDER BY book, code

req.sql: SELECT code, subsystem, status, topic, next FROM requirements WHERE code = ? OR lower(topic) LIKE lower(?) ORDER BY code

wkf.sql: SELECT book, code, name, kind, version, steps FROM workflows WHERE code = ? OR lower(name) LIKE lower(?) ORDER BY book, code

file.sql: SELECT path, system, version, bytes, lines FROM files WHERE lower(path) LIKE lower(?) ORDER BY path

tool.sql: SELECT family, version, code, activated_at, path FROM tools ORDER BY family

lamp.sql: SELECT kind, id, event, lamp, file, ts FROM ledger WHERE lower(id) LIKE lower(?) ORDER BY ts DESC

changed.sql: SELECT change, path, prev_sha, sha FROM changes ORDER BY change, path
changed.what: 跟上一次 build 比:新增 · 改了 · 不見
